question: Which Articles of the Indian Constitution are related with the Right against Exploitation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**23 to 24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Articles 23 and 24 of the Indian constitution give people the right against exploitation which guarantees human dignity and protects them from any kind of exploitation. 
 
• **Article 23 (1) prohibits the trafficking of humans and forced labour.**
